text:
gloria: Thinking out loud — proposing a "fission-braid" approach to untangle the hotpath: split the inference request flow into a thin router + stateful affinity sidecar and a stateless handler for model execution. Goal is to reduce blast radius for KV cache churn and make feature rollouts safer.

amir: can you sketch the staged migration? big picture please.

gloria: Stage 0: no runtime change, feature-flag the router layer. Stage 1: introduce sidecar behind a proxy but keep full-traffic on old path. Stage 2: redirect 5% canary to sidecar + stateless handler. Stage 3: expand and flip.

sophie: Concern: latency tail. sidecar hops add ~0.7ms in lab. Any plans for batching semantics when split?

gloria: Yes — keep batching at the handler (stateless exec). Sidecar only handles affinity, prefix cache lookup, and sharding hints. Handler owns batching and KV cache reads for minibatches.

ryan: Rollout + SLO ops note: start with canary 0.5% during peak, 5% outside peak, run for 48h. Need automated rollback on  p95 > baseline + 20%.

amir: How do we backfill existing KV prefixes? migration tech debt: some tenants wrote heuristics into enrichment layer.

gloria: Plan: migration job that snapshots prefix->state and writes to sidecar-backed store. Small correctness harness: sample traffic replays against both paths and diff outputs.

ryan: For safety, add a deterministic fallback: if sidecar returns nothing after X ms, router falls back to old handler. Also add traffic shadow for 100% to catch regressions.

infra-bot: deploy notice: canary-prep pipeline passed for branch "fission-braid/ready" — staging artifacts available at https://ci.redwood.example/builds/23892

sophie: Observability checklist: token-level latency, per-tenant error rate, cache hit ratio, batching distribution, and output-diff alerts. We should tag spans with "fission_braid_phase" and "handler_version".

amir: Also need cost model: splitting may increase egress and sidecar CPU. Estimate delta on small tenants first.

gloria: I'll add a cost estimate column to the rollout doc. main unknowns: prefix read amplification and extra RPCs.

ryan: Quick config snippet for canary routing we can reuse in console:
```
route:
  strategy: weighted
  targets:
    - name: legacy-handler
      weight: 95
    - name: fission-braid-handler
      weight: 5
fallback:
  timeout_ms: 120
  fallback_target: legacy-handler
```

sophie: prometheus query to watch during canary: `sum(rate(inference_requests_total{route="fission-braid-handler"}[1m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`

amir: test harness idea: replay 10k historical requests with randomized latency noise and assert output-drift < 0.2% on classifier labels, BLEU-ish threshold for generative outputs.

gloria: agree. also add eval set for hallucination-sensitive prompts.

ryan: Ops: add rollout playbook steps to console deployment flow: precheck scripts, smoke canary, scale test, full shadow run, cutover. If anything > threshold — immediate rollback.

gloria: Will draft RFC follow-up with expected timelines (4 weeks for prototype, 8–12 weeks for staged rollout) and a matrix of risks/mitigations. tagging folks for reviews: @amir @sophie @ryan. :rocket:

amir: ack, will review RFC and add migration job sketch.

sophie: will list observability dashboards needed.

ryan: i'll wire the rollouts into the runbook and add automated checks.

infra-bot: note: created issue INF-2483 "fission-braid rollout checklist" assigned to gloria.
